About this review collection

Imported October 29, 2026 from the supplied Google Reviews text file. This is not a live feed or a claim that these are all reviews currently on Google. Relative dates are preserved as captured; the original capture date is unknown. Star ratings, profile links and photos were not included in the supplied text, so none have been invented for the individual entries. The overall rating and distribution above were checked against Tom’s current Google profile on October 29, 2026. Some records contain no written text, and one or more copied reviews may be truncated. Historical prices and owner contact details inside reviews may no longer be current.

Default order follows the supplied file. Search covers reviewer names, written feedback and owner responses. Filters apply only to whether written text or an owner reply was supplied.

Read the review

I went for a self-service car wash. There are 3-4 ports. Everything is clean, i.e. no mud on the floor from the off-road bros. The machines themselves are, um, vintage and take quarters only. I get that self-service carwashes probably don't bring in much money and hence there's not much money available for hardware upgrades. But the cycle of loading in quarters and scurrying back to complete the various stages of car washing wastes wash time and is not optimal in general. I would prefer paying either via bills or best case scenario, via credit card. Aside from the quarters snag, everything is in order, all of the washing modes are available and the car wash is clean. No experience with the automatic wash.

Response from Tom’s

2 years ago · as shown in the source

Christy thanks for your review. Tom’s in Royersford? Our bays are the last ones in the country that start on one quarter, and our automatic is 2 -3 dollars under the average New touch -less auto. Our vacuums have been one dollar for the last 15 years… Unfortunately we had to raise our prices due to the outrageous costs from our new water/sewer company in the area. Who have tripled our costs. The touchless automatics use approximately 45 gallons of water per wash and a bit more chemicals then a typical express tunnel. We do pride ourselves in using the best presoaks, sealants, and waxes, and ceramics available. What other washes offer as a “$3-$4 buy up” or “add on” , we include in our top wash. All that said we do offer a great discount for fleet members. No minimum required.
